newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan seeks new bids for 30,000 tonnes basmati.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan seeks new bids for 30,000 tonnes basmati.

text.p: The state-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan (RECP) said on Monday it had invited fresh bids for the sale and export of 30,000 tonnes of 1995/96 (July-June) basmati rice including seven percent broken.
An RECP official said bids should be submitted by Sunday.
The RECP scrapped its previous attempt to auction 30,000 tonnes of basmati after receiving two bids at the weekend.

These were $421 per tonne FOB from Hamid al-Faris of Saudi Arabia and a much lower one from a Pakistan-based firm -- both well below the $433.75 per tonne FOB fetched at the last auction of 10,000 tonnes of basmati in August.
